def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                        ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                                grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                            seen.add((ny, nx))
                            stack.append((ny, nx))
            components.append(cells)

    squares = []
    for cells in components:
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1 - r0 == c1 - c0:
            squares.append((r1 - r0, cells, r0, c0))

    _, cells, r0, c0 = min(squares, key=lambda item: item[0])
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    cell_set = set(cells)
    return [[grid[r][c] if (r, c) in cell_set else 0
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
